title: Refund timing
text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Most card refunds appear within five to ten business days after approval.

title: Invoice tax details
text: Invoices list regional tax separately when local rules require it. Billing admins can download receipts from the billing settings page.

title: Webhook timeout troubleshooting
text: Webhook endpoints should respond within ten seconds. Retry failed webhook events from the developer console after fixing network or server issues.

title: API token rotation
text: Create a new API token, deploy it to your application, verify traffic, and then revoke the old token. Never log tokens or commit them to source control.

title: Account recovery
text: Users locked out by two-factor authentication should use recovery codes or contact an organization admin to reset authentication settings.

title: Admin invitations
text: Workspace owners can invite admins from the members page. The invitee must accept the email invitation before permissions become active.

title: Support availability
text: Standard support is available Monday through Friday. Urgent incidents can be submitted from the support portal.

title: Release notes
text: Release notes summarize new features, bug fixes, and known issues. They are published in the documentation site after each release.
